$comment: The bounded metric catalog (ADR-0125). Single source of truth: the runtime imports it (telemetry-catalog.ts) and the CI guard (scripts/telemetry-label-guard.mjs) JSON-parses it. Every metric's labels MUST be a subset of labelAllowlist, and NO label key may be id-shaped (tenant/org/endpoint/event/url/...) — that is what keeps metric cardinality, and cost, bounded independent of tenant count. Slice 3 wires emission to these names; this file is the contract.

delivery.attempts.help: Outbound delivery attempts by response class and attempt bucket.

delivery.duration_ms.help: Outbound delivery attempt duration by response class.

delivery.retries.help: Outbound delivery retries scheduled by response class.

cron.runs.help: Scheduled cron/job runs by job and result.
